pokedexEntries.sw: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

pokedexEntries.sh: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

pokedexEntries.sc: It’s said that the reason behind Corvisquire’s high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.vi: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.

pokedexEntries.za: Corvisquire are intelligent enough to use tools. They'll use their feet to pick up and fling pebbles or wrap their enemies in ropes.
